nodes.text: If this thought too should steal into anyone’s mind, that if we acknowledged God as our helper we would not, as we say [we are], be overpowered and punished by unjust men, I will resolve this too. God, having made the whole world, and having subjected earthly things to men, and having ordered the heavenly elements for the growth of crops and the changes of the seasons, and having laid down a divine law for them, things which he evidently made, they too, for the sake of men, handed over the care of men and of things beneath heaven to angels, whom he set over these. But the angels transgressed this order, were overcome by intercourse with women, and begot children, who are those called demons. And besides, they then enslaved the human race to themselves, partly through magical writings, partly through the fears and punishments which they inflicted, and partly through teaching sacrifices and incense and libations, of which they had come to stand in need after they were enslaved to the passions of desire; and among men they sowed murders, wars, adulteries, licentiousness and every vice. Hence poets and mythologists, not knowing that it was the angels and the demons begotten from them who did these things to males and females and cities and nations, which they recorded, ascribed them to God himself and to those born as sons, so to speak, from his seed, and to his so-called brothers, Poseidon and Pluto, and likewise to the children born from them. For they called each by the name which each of the angels had given to himself and to his children.
